# NeXify AI

> Premium B2B agency for AI-assisted websites, online shops, web/mobile apps and automation. Transparent day rate €449 net. Primary markets: DACH + Netherlands. German UI default; Dutch seat in Venlo.

NeXify AI (Eenmanszaak, Pascal Courbois) delivers personal specialist work accelerated with AI tools — not anonymous agency overhead. Contact for project estimates within one working day, or use the on-site AI advisor chat.
